## Rule

Gridline-adjacent fill: select ch1 rows/cols based on whether they are "edge" rows/cols (only ch1 at one end), have ≥4 ch1 cells, or have exactly 3 ch1 cells with at least 2 adjacent. Mark ch0 background cells that are within the bounding box of selected rows AND within the bounding box of selected cols as "fill" (move to ch2 area). Output: ch0 without filled cells, original ch1, fill mask.

## Algorithm sketch

75 nodes, opset 10. Key:
1. `Slice(input, ch0) → ch0 [1,1,30,30]`; `Slice(input, ch1) → ch1 [1,1,30,30]`
2. `ReduceSum(ch1, axis=3) → row_count [1,1,30,1]`; `ReduceSum(ch1, axis=2) → col_count [1,1,1,30]`
3. `MaxPool(Cast(row_count>0.5), kernel=[30,1], ...)` (cumulative from top/bottom) → row_in_bbox
4. Detect edge rows: `row_edge = row_has AND NOT(prev_row) AND NOT(next_row)` (only ch1 at one end of the span)
5. Detect adj pairs: `Conv(ch1, [1,2] kernel) → adj_pair_counts [30,29]`; `ReduceMax → row/col adj count`
6. Row selection: `row_sel = (row_edge OR row_ge4 OR (row_eq3 AND row_adj))`
7. `row_fill = row_sel[30,1] × col_in_bbox[1,30] → [30,30]`; `col_fill = col_sel[1,30] × row_in_bbox[30,1] → [30,30]`
8. `line_fill = Cast(Greater(Add(row_fill, col_fill), 0.5)) → [30,30]`; `fill_mask = line_fill × ch0`
9. `Concat(ch0-fill_mask, ch1, fill_mask, zero×7)` → output [1,10,30,30]

## Cost analysis

Live cost 46688 (memory=46604, params=84). Key intermediates:
- ch0, ch1: 2×3600B = 7200B (unavoidable input slices)
- row_fill, col_fill: 2×3600B = 7200B (narrow-broadcast outer products, cannot avoid [30,30] output)
- line_fill_sum, line_fill_b (bool), line_fill: old total 8100B; after v1: just line_fill 3600B
- fill_mask, new_ch0: 2×3600B = 7200B (unavoidable output channels)
- glaf_zero: 3600B (used 7× in Concat for zero-channels 3-9; Sub(ch1,ch1) is cheapest way to get it)
- adj_pair_counts: 2×3480B = 6960B (Conv outputs, needed for adjacent-pair detection)

## Don't-do log

- 2026-05-18 | Replace Sub(ch1,ch1)→glaf_zero with initializer or ConstantOfShape: saves 3600B memory but adds 3600B params → net cost change = 0. Not worth it.
- 2026-05-18 | Eliminate row_fill or col_fill [30,30]: they come from narrow×narrow broadcasting; the [30,30] output is necessary for line_fill computation. No workaround without changing the algorithm.
